Simple purées

Banana mash

Banánpüré

6 months+ Adjusted 5 min 2 portions

Offer a little mashed banana, not banana at every meal. Put an iron-rich food on the table the same day.

Best eaten fresh.

Ingredients

  • 1 ripe banana (yellow with brown spots, peeled)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Peel a ripe banana.
  2. Mash it with a fork until completely smooth.
  3. Serve half now and keep the other half covered for the next meal the same day.
  4. Do not add sugar, and do not offer this as the meal every day.

Adjusted

Banana is low in iron, so it is a poor everyday staple. A lot of banana can slow the bowels.

Mash a ripe banana and offer a small portion now and then, not as the main food each day. Keep meat, lentils, or egg in other meals so iron is not missed.
